Subject: Request: offsec assessment package for SIG/CAIQ GRC upload

Hi Kimberly,

We're preparing our vendor SIG/CAIQ submission for this quarter and Horizon's GRC team flagged the penetration test report as a required evidence artifact for your profile. Can you please share the following so we can complete the upload by Aug 12: 

- Full penetration test report (redacted as needed) or a redacted PDF suitable for public sharing
- Executive summary / scope page in a separate file
- SIG mapping sheet (if you have one) showing where the test maps to CAIQ control IDs
- Remediation tracker CSV (current open findings + status / ETA)

If there are parts that must remain internal, please highlight them and we can mark them non-public in the portal. Also let us know if you need the portal link or a specific folder name.

Thanks — Darren

Darren.Smith@horizonhealth.com
+1 617-555-0112

Hi Darren — thanks for the heads up.

We can provide the materials you requested. Quick notes up front:

- We'll upload a redacted PDF of the full penetration test report. Redactions will be limited to customer-identifying data and low-level IP (e.g., exploit PoCs) per our disclosure policy.
- We'll include an executive summary and a CAIQ mapping sheet (XLSX) that ties findings to control IDs.
- Our remediation tracker will be provided as a CSV showing status, owner, and ETA.

Planned timeline:
- Today (Aug 8): prepare redacted report + exec summary + mapping sheet (we'll attach a preliminary mapping)
- Aug 9 morning: internal review and sign-off from security (Rishi)
- Aug 9 afternoon: upload to your portal and post link here

I've attached a short Offsec summary and the mapping stub for your intake team to review. If your portal requires a specific file naming convention or folder, please send it over.

Also, for the CAIQ mapping, do you prefer the full mapping worksheet or a condensed view that only shows tested controls?

Regards,

Kimberly Park
Security Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Kimberly — thank you. Horizon GRC prefers the full mapping sheet (we will mark untested controls as N/A) and the full redacted report. A few portal notes below:

- Upload link: https://grc.horizonhealth.com/upload?org=HorizonHealth&folder=Redwood_Inference
- Folder name: "Vendors/Redwood Inference/2027 Q3 Evidence"
- Please include a single CSV named "redwood_remediation_tracker_2027-08-09.csv" with the columns: finding_id, severity, status, owner, eta, notes.

Ideally we get everything uploaded by EOD Aug 9 so the intake team can validate by Aug 12. If you need more time, let me know the blockers.

Also, if you can attach an attestation sentence or short statement confirming the report is the most recent penetration assessment performed by (vendor name) on (date), that helps our audit reviewers.

I'll assign the intake ticket to our team once the files are in the folder.

Regards,
Darren

[Portal note: files uploaded to the link above are scanned and stored for 365 days by default]
